description: Configures Hermes to orchestrate A-Wiki lifecycle skills across all agents

platform_notes.claude_code: Subagents auto-discovered from agents/ directory. Agent Teams available with CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1.
platform_notes.kilo: Load persona via skill tool or reference agents/<name>.md
platform_notes.codex: AGENTS.md intent mapping defines persona routing

domain_routing._description: SO2 — when --domain <d> is passed to persona-orchestrator.py, use these domain-specific review personas/subagents instead of the generic parallel_fan_out. Hermes is SEQUENTIAL-only (no parallel fan-out), so 'fan-out' here means 'which personas run in the sequential pass'. Unknown domains fall back to personas.parallel_fan_out.

shortcut_blocklist.message: No code without failing test (Iron Law #1). No implementation without spec for non-trivial changes.
Review gate required before SHIP phase. Run /review or parallel fan-out.
Test-Driven Development: write failing test first, then implement.
Architectural decisions require an ADR. Document why before committing.

lifecycle_routing._a_suite_note: The DEFINE..SHIP phases above are the Hermes orchestration contract and stay as-is. A-Suite is the 7-phase user-facing spine (ask -> design -> plan -> implement -> review -> debug -> test); its entry points are linked into the Hermes skill root by scripts/hermes/link_awiki_skills.py and are answerable as /a-router /a-plan /a-debug /a-doc /a-council /a-loop /a-escalate /a-claim /a-think. Full trigger table: wiki/A-ROUTER.md.
